description: Asked to work on an issue -> should invoke before starting
notes: Expected after invoking: read the issue body and Arch Review, decide whether it is a structural change, then start. If it is a structural change without a GO, ask for the GO instead of opening an implementation PR

description: Verbal request to add a new skill -> should invoke and send it to architecture review as a structural change
user_message: review プラグインに、リリースノートを書くスキルを足して。
notes: Adding a new skill is a structural change. Expected after invoking: don't open an implementation PR right away; present the design (location, relation to other parts) and ask for a GO. If it takes several steps, also propose making an issue

description: Implementation request in English -> should invoke
user_message: Please fix the off-by-one bug in the pagination helper and open a PR.
notes: Expected after invoking: a one-off request, so no issue is created; write `Refs: none (verbal request)` and `Arch-Review: not-needed — <reason>` in the PR body

description: Asked whether it is OK to merge mid-review -> should invoke and check the conditions

notes: Expected after invoking: check that every review tool has produced results (a rate limit means not reviewed) and that `## Result` is written in the issue Closes points to; if anything is missing, say what
